Title: [Upcoming] CLO-SET Pricing Plan Renewal FAQ
Content: Objective Find the list of frequently asked questions and answers regarding the new CLO-SET Pricing Plan Renewal, upcoming starting November 04, 2024. Plan Types What's changing? How is the expected price calculated? When does it start? What do I have to do? How can I get 2 months for free? Details 1) Plan Types Starting November 5th, CLO-SET will be available in Free, Standard, and Premium Plan. Enterprise Plan will continue to be available. Premium ($40/user): for small &amp medium businesses Standard ($20/user): for small teams Free: for first time users *Enterprise Plan: for large organizations aiming to scale securely and efficiently. 2) What's Changing? More Options: CLO-SET will start providing 2 paid plans, Standard and Premium, tailored for your team size and your 3D journey. Choose the plan that is just right for your team. Enjoy Advanced Features: CLO-SET Advanced features that were previously unavailable under Free Plan will be open to all plan types, including Tech Pack and High Quality Render. All Members Counted: Under the new pricing plan, all permissions will be a valued 'Paying user', with all the benefits that come with it. 3) How is the expected price calculated? CLO-SET will recommend a plan type for you based on your Group's recent usage. On the pop-up modal, you can find more details in table form. Expand the table to see which feature your Group has been using the most. Alternatively, visit Console &gtBilling &gt Usage History to view historic data. Based on the recommended plan type, the total expected amount is calculated based on the [Price Per User * Number of Users currently in your Group]. Please note that the displayed price are for reference only. Based on your Group's future usage, we recommend that you choose a plan right for your team. Find more details on the new pricing plans here. 4) When does it start? The new pricing plan will be effective November 5th, 2024. Effective payment date will be determined following your Group's Measurement Period. For example, if your Group's measurement period is renewed on November 5th, your Group will start paying for the new plans on November 5th (unless you pre-apply for the Trial). However, if your Group's measurement period is renewed on November 2nd (before the effective date) and again on December 1st, your Group will start paying for the new plans on December 1st (unless you pre-apply for the Trial). Measurement Period is fixed at 30 days for all Groups. Apply now to receive the 2-month trial period. Application open until November 4th, 2024. If applied, your 2-month trial period will begin on the your Group's first renewal date post-November 5th. For example, if your Group's measurement period is renewed on November 5th, your Trial begins November 5th, up to Jan 4th. If your Group's measurement period is renewed on November 2nd (before the effective date) and again on December 1st, your Group Trial begins December 1st, up to Jan 31st. Until the effective date or the start of Trial, your Group's billing will follow current pricing model. 5) What do I have to do? By November 4th, apply to receive the 2-month Trial Period for your Group. From November 5th, select a Plan to use and register your payment information on CLO-SET. Note that the actual payment may differ for all Groups. Please check your billing cycle for the exact date. In the meantime, you are recommended to review and plan your Group's usage if possible, and select the right Plan that works best for your Group. Please keep in mind that having certain number of users or having certain number of new Workroom created may require upgrading to a higher plan. 6) How do I get 2 months Trial for free? Follow instructions on the Pop-up modal on your CLO-SET Dashboard. Go to www.style.clo-set.com and sign in to your account to get started. *If you have closed the pop-up modal without applying for the Trial, you will be able to apply again the next day.

Title: Search
Content: Pricing Plan: All (Enterprise, Advanced, Free) Objective Find your Contents with the search feature in CLO-SET. Find it fast. Find it easy. Search Tab Keyword Search Image Search Filters View / Sort Option Workroom/Assortment Search Details 1) Search Tab Access the Search tab from the dashboard. Click the 'Search' icon on the far left. Keyword search Image search Reset search options Filter search results View/Sort option 2) Text Search Search using the Content Name, Creator, or Content ID. Please note that only the Contents to which you have access to will be displayed as the search result. 3) Image Search To start searching with image files, click on 'search by image' icon next to the magnifier icon. Upload an image file, and click 'Apply'. CLO-SET AI will detect the shape, color, and pattern and find similar Contents. Start searching with image files such as: Rendered output of your Content Physical image of the design Pattern images used for the Content 4) Filters Use Search filters to expand or narrow down the search results. Learn what each of the filters indicate: Content Type: Each Content is classified as a single Content Type. You may select the Content Type at the time of upload, or CLO-SET will auto-assign one based on your file format. Space: Select a Company, Brand, or Workroom Space to conduct the search. Click on the icon view lower-level Spaces. Once the selection is made, click 'Next'. User must have 'Viewer' or above permission to select the respective Space. Workflow / Category: Can only be applied once the Space selection is made. 5) View/Sort Option Modify viewing and sorting options: View By: Contents: Search results will show each Content only Colorway: Search results will show each Colorway of the Content Sort By: Last Modified Name: Sorting based on the file name. Workflow: Sorting based on the Workflow steps identified from your Company Settings 6) Workroom/Assortment Search Users can search for a specific Workroom or Assortment by its name. Select the 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' option from the 'Search For' drop down next to the search bar. 1. In Company, Brand, Line, Season From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within a specific Space (Company, Brand, or Line), ALL associated Workrooms/Assortments within that Space will be displayed Hover over the Workroom to view the location path 2. In Season From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within the selected Season Please note that the search results will only display either Workrooms or Assortments per your selection. 3. In Workroom From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' Contents of Current Room: search the Contents within the current level Workroom only Contents Including Child Rooms: search the contents from the current Workroom and all its child Workrooms. Workrooms: search the Child Workrooms within the current Workroom Type in the keyword to search for Child Workrooms. Search results display all Child Workrooms with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders)

Title: Visual Board
Content: Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor Plan Type: All (Advanced, Free, Trial) Objective Understand how to create/edit/share Visual Board in CLO-SET What is Visual Board? User Scenario Create Edit Mode Utilizing 3D Assets Edit Mode UI Invite &amp Share Export to PDF Permission &amp Notification Shortcut keys Details 1) What is Visual Board? Visual Board is a creation tool for showcasing your design using the 3D assets in CLO-SET. Users can now create Lookbooks or Moodboards with the 3D assets. Create Lookbook, Moodboard, or Presentation with your Assets Collaborate with your team online Drag &amp Drop 3D assets to add 2D Images with a click 2) User Scenario 3) Create Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor From your dashboard, click on 'Workspace' &gt 'Visual Board' Click '+' to create a new Visual Board Enter the title and description, then click 'Create' [Please Note] Only the creator of the Board &amp Group Admin will have access to the Board. Invite new members as Editors to the Board for collaboration. Editors of the Group will NOT be automatically added to the Board. 4) Edit Mode Permission: Group Admin, Board Creator, Board Editor (directly shared from Board's Share tab) Start editing the Board. You may use ALL assets you have access to within the Group. Please note: only 1 user can edit the Board at a time. While 1 user is editing, others can view Slide Show or Comments. Slide Show will be based on the last saved version. Make sure to click 'Save' once the work is complete. Click 'Share' to add Board Editors to grant edit access. Group members will NOT be automatically added. You must add the user as Editor to each Board for collaboration. Advanced Plan users: When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. [Utilizing 3D Assets] To add your Contents/Files on the board, start dragging &amp dropping the Content from the right pane to the slide. When adding the Content, you have an option to embed a link to 3D viewer, Content Page, or Customer URL. Add Images: Select view(s) to add. Zprj/Zpac files: Select from Thumbnail, Front, Left, Right, and Back view. Other file types: Add Thumbnail image. Link (URL): Create hyperlink to the 3D Viewer, Content Page, or Custom URL to the image. [Colorway Options] Select 'By Colorway' to add Images of different Colorways. By Content: displays Default Colorway (last selected when saved in CLO software). By Colorway: displays selected Colorway. Thumbnail: customizable on the original Content Page. [Edit Mode UI] Title: Title of the Board. Click to make changes. Save, Slide Show, Exit Save: save the current version Slide Show: preview and share slide show [Coming Soon] Export the Board Exit: leave edit mode. Changes will not be saved Share Edit Permission is unique for each Board. You must have Editor permission to the specific Board to make changes. Group Admin can access/edit/delete all Boards as a default. Creator of the Board automatically has Editor permission to the Board Add other members to the Board as Editors to collaborate. Group members will NOT be automatically granted permission to edit the Board. Adding a new Editor to the Board will include the invitee as a Group member. Slide List: add, duplicate, or delete each slide Edit Toolbar: add or edit components on/to your slide Edit Toolbar Bubble Toolbar Available Color Palettes please note: custom palettes uploaded as color preset are not yet supported in Visual Board Picker PANTONE coloro Slide Background / Undo &amp Redo Background: Select the background color of each slide Undo &amp Redo the edit action Search &amp Filter: find the Asset within the Group, or select the Space to find the Content. Asset List: Drag &amp Drop the Asset to the Board to add an Image. You can only use Assets you have permission to. Change Order: Select the object(s) and right click to change the order. Single Select: change the order of a single object. Bring to front: bring the object to the very front of the slide Bring forward: bring the object to move forward by 1 layer Send to back: bring the object to the very back of the slide (excluding background) Send backward: bring the object to move back by 1 layer Multi Select: change the order of multiple objects together. Order among the selected objects will remain. Bring to front: bring the objects selected the very front of the slide as a group Send to back: bring the objects selected to the very back of the slide as a group (excluding background) 4) Invite &amp Share (Slide Show Mode) Add Editor (Add Board Editor for collaboration) Click the 'Share' button at the top-right corner to add Board Editors Default: Only the Board Creator and Group Admin can edit. Add new Editors to each Board to grant Edit permission. Advanced Plan users: When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. Share &amp Publish (Share the slide show with external users) From Slide Show mode, click on the 'Share' button at the top-right corner Restricted: Only you and Can Edit member can access the slide show with link Publish: Anyone with link can view the slide show 6) Export to PDF On the Edit page, you can now export the Visual Board to a PDF. Selected Page: only export the selected page (single slide) All Pages: export the full Board (all slides) On the Edit page, you can now export the Visual Board to a PDF. Selected Page: only export the selected page (single slide) All Pages: export the full Board (all slides) 7) Permission &amp Notification Permission to Visual Board Please note: Group members are NOT automatically granted access to all Boards. You must be added as an Editor to each Board to view/make changes to unpublished Boards. Notification Manage notifications regarding Visual Board on My Page Notification sent to: Group Admin, Board Creator, and Board Editors (anyone added to each Board with 'Can Edit' permission) 8) Shortcut Keys Key Details Ctrl/Command + z Ctrl/Command + y Undo Redo Ctrl/Command + a Select all objects Shift + h Shift + v Flip (horizontal) Flip (vertical) v i t b l p c Select Tool Image Tool Text Tool Pencil Tool Line Tool Curve Tool Shapes Tool [ Ctrl/Command + [ ] Ctrl/Command + ] Bring to front Bring forward Send to back Send backward
